sections.heading: 1. Habits + shoulder exercises
lines: ① Keep bags on the front seat or in the boot.
② Need it? Hop out and open the back door.
③ Push hand back into door frame, 20 sec × 5.
④ Wall slides, 10 reps, comfortable range.

caption:
Lulu reached from the driver's seat to drag the tool bag off the back seat, and now the shoulder twinges.

Twisting and reaching back asks the shoulder to hold weight at the end of its range. Never reach back while driving, and hopping out to grab the bag is kinder on the shoulder too.

Hybi's shoulder care: keep bags on the front seat or in the boot, push the back of your hand into a door frame for 20 seconds × 5, and do 10 wall slides in a comfortable range.

Trouble lifting the arm or pain that wakes you at night is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
